summary.business_type: E-commerce specialty coffee and instant premix brand with a local Bengaluru experience-center presence
top_findings: Spam review is published in Product JSON-LD and counted in Morning Buzz aggregateRating
Homepage contains placeholder copy, three H1 elements, and no meta description
XML sitemaps expose utility, redirected, template, form, author, and default-content URLs
Homepage transfers about 65 MB in mobile Lighthouse, including about 58.9 MB of video
Product/category content and Product schema lack important commerce and trust details
quick_wins: Remove the spam review and recalculate aggregateRating
Replace homepage placeholder copy and use one descriptive H1
Remove noindex and junk URLs from XML sitemaps
Add homepage title, meta description, canonical, and Organization JSON-LD
Remove high fetch priority from the logo and prioritize the real LCP asset
limitations: No Google Search Console, GA4, Merchant Center, or Google Business Profile access
No CrUX field data; performance measurements are mobile Lighthouse lab data
Platform-specific AI citation visibility was not measured

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS and canonical host redirects work
Primary content is present in raw HTML

findings.title: Sitemap includes low-value and non-indexable URLs
findings.description: The 47-URL sitemap includes cart, checkout, account, default post, builder templates, form artifacts, and author archives.
findings.recommendation: Submit only 200, canonical, indexable URLs and noindex or delete junk content.

findings.title: Canonical coverage is inconsistent
findings.description: Sampled shop and product-category pages had no canonical tag.
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing canonical metadata to every indexable template.

findings.title: Security headers are incomplete
findings.description: HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy were absent on the live WordPress response.
findings.recommendation: Add and test modern security headers without overstating their SEO impact.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Founder and sourcing story are present
Contact information and legal policies are published

findings.title: Homepage contains visible placeholder copy
findings.description: Lorem Ipsum and an irrelevant recipe CTA appear in primary homepage content.
findings.recommendation: Replace unfinished copy with query-aligned brand and product information.

findings.title: Health and function claims lack visible evidence
findings.description: Immune, gut-health, and glycemic claims do not show studies, doses, or qualified sources.
findings.recommendation: Obtain compliance review and cite evidence or soften/remove unsupported claims.

findings.title: Product and category content is shallow
findings.description: Priority pages omit ingredients, nutrition, preparation, shelf life, manufacturer/FSSAI details, logistics, and selection guidance.
findings.recommendation: Add complete, unique purchase-supporting content and internal links.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Product pages have a single product H1
Breadcrumb navigation exists on product pages
Commercial page types broadly match search intent

findings.title: Homepage has three H1 elements and no meta description
findings.description: The title is only Bean Leaf Brew and the heading hierarchy is fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Use one descriptive H1 and unique, query-aligned title and description.

findings.title: Product metadata is generic or excessively long
findings.description: Titles omit product attributes and sample product descriptions are 430-472 characters.
findings.recommendation: Use product/category metadata templates and concise benefit-led descriptions.

findings.title: Editorial internal linking is weak
findings.description: The site lacks a guide hub connecting education content with categories and products.
findings.recommendation: Publish high-intent guides and link them bidirectionally.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Product and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD is server-rendered on product pages
Core product name, image, description, seller, and offer information is present

findings.title: Spam review contaminates Product rating
findings.description: An unrelated link-spam review is included in Morning Buzz review JSON-LD and aggregateRating.
findings.recommendation: Remove it, recalculate the rating, and moderate schema-bound reviews.

findings.title: Variant and offer data does not match visible products
findings.description: AggregateOffer offerCount is 18 while only two weights are visibly purchasable; SKU and breadcrumb values are also inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Model real variants and align every schema value with visible content.

findings.title: Homepage entity graph is missing
findings.description: Homepage and About page contained no JSON-LD blocks.
findings.recommendation: Add linked Organization, WebSite, WebPage, founder, and truthful location entities.

findings.title: Homepage payload is about 65 MB
findings.description: Five MP4 files total about 58.9 MB; Speed Index was 16.9 seconds.
findings.recommendation: Use poster-first delivery, one optimized hero loop at most, and load secondary video only on interaction.

findings.title: LCP misses the recommended threshold
findings.description: Mobile Lighthouse LCP was 2.9 seconds; no field data was available.
findings.recommendation: Optimize the LCP asset and validate with 28 days of CrUX field data.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Search-focused AI crawlers are not specifically blocked
Primary content is available in raw HTML

findings.title: Content is not consistently citable
findings.description: Placeholder copy, generic marketing language, unsupported claims, and incomplete product facts reduce passage quality.
findings.recommendation: Publish concise answer-first product facts and evidence-led guides with primary-source citations.

findings.title: llms.txt is absent
findings.description: The endpoint returns 404, but this is not a Google visibility lever.
findings.recommendation: Do not prioritize llms.txt ahead of core content, schema, performance, and entity work.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Many below-fold images use native lazy loading

findings.title: Empty alt text is widespread
findings.description: 31 of 53 homepage images and 18 of 22 House Brew images use empty alt attributes; some may be decorative but require review.
findings.recommendation: Add accurate alt to informative images and retain empty alt only for decorative assets.

findings.title: Large PNG files and priority hints are inefficient
findings.description: Key PNGs range from about 275 KB to 810 KB, and the logo is prioritized instead of the likely LCP asset.
findings.recommendation: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP and prioritize the actual LCP image.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Remove spam review and recalculate ratings
Replace homepage placeholder content and heading structure
Clean XML sitemaps and noindex/delete junk URLs

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Expand product and category buying content

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Publish founder, roastery, estate, and sourcing proof
Publish high-intent brewing and selection guides
Implement verified reviews and Merchant Center

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Track Search Console coverage and query performance
Track rich-result and Merchant Center errors
